name: Superb Fabricating
old_description: Superb Fabricating specializes in metal fabrication and prototype development.
about:
Superb Fabricating operates from a facility at 330 North Reese Street in South Lyon, Michigan, where it runs a metal fabrication shop focused on prototype development and production runs. The business is organized as a limited liability company, though the exact founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides laser cutting, press brake forming, welding and fabrication, CNC programming, and assembly development, supported by what it describes as state-of-the-art equipment. Specific machine models, facility square footage, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

The company serves customers in automotive, medical, aerospace, film production, and green energy sectors, supplying components ranging from prototype parts to longer production runs. Its client base spans industrial and artistic projects alike.

Superb Fabricating emphasizes a blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern technology, and it highlights reliable on-time delivery at competitive prices as key to its approach. The firm also points to its relationships with quality material suppliers and a commitment to high standards in both the products it uses and produces.
